name: assumption-check
description: A side pane of the assumptions Claude makes, one dropdown per prompt, with counts that filter: mark one right, or wrong (type the fix or let Claude ask), ask why, open its source, or delete it. On from the start, /assumption-check off to stop; nothing in the pane reaches Claude unless you press wrong or why.

startOn.title: Start on
startOn.description: Turn assumption capture on in every session (the default). Off, Claude works exactly as without the mod until you run /assumption-check on.
